svg.title: Review Grows With the Stakes
svg.desc: A review ladder that rises with the stakes: your own read for personal notes, a quick author check for internal updates, a sample review for routine high-volume replies, and full review by a qualified person for decisions about money, health, legal rights or jobs, who must have authority to change it and must tell the person AI was involved; disclaimers, spelling checks and Claude's own uncertainty flags are not review.
svg.text: The more that rides on it, the more qualified the reviewer.
Full review by a qualified person
Claim-decline letter; health, legal or money content
Tell the person AI was involved
